items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I was only late one time in my career, and that was when I was playing a show with Elliott Lawrence conducting.

ctx.x: Now, did this cause any problems between you all and Lukoford?

No, long as we were there on time. You know, Stan, I never miss time. That's why right today I have a natural habit of looking at a clock. All day long I look at a clock, checking that time. I was only late one time in my career, and that was when I was playing a show with Elliott Lawrence conducting.
Well, I was laying in bed and --
